directionReview: User accepts currently demonstrated VFX direction. User could not open local HTML UI preview and requests richer drawn UI. New painted resonance chamber is a single UI candidate for direct PNG review; not full UI approval.

runtime.type: Graphics/CSS plus candidate RGBA summon and plasma textures
runtime.dimensions: UI CSS pixels / VFX world units. New turret PNG/WebP 1536x1024; shared runtime texture 512x341, visual width64.

pivot.portrait: top-aligned display crop only; original image pivot unchanged

runtime.alpha: Renderer geometry alpha plus straight-alpha WebP for first summon candidate. No raster animation atlas.

blend.hazard: NORMAL depth20; enemy true boundaries above VFX

animation.clock: Combat.time / Flash.life / Field.until; continuous procedural render, no sprite-frame animation
animation.persistent: Active field/dash/status lifespan from the simulation
animation.reduced: Static textured beam body and summon body remain; optional haze/charge/contact/flow ornaments omitted; enemy effective boundaries unchanged.
animation.damage: Simulation only; renderer has no callbacks or RNG

sourcePolicy.artwork: All original art unchanged. 32 same-composition mechanical WebP thumbnails derive from existing character portraits; source/output hashes in separate UI manifest. Existing turret/plasma candidates retained.
sourcePolicy.referenceScope: Stella Maiden source actions and static ray/focus/wormhole vocabulary; existing navy/cyan/gold UI baseline informed by prior NIKKE reference notes. New procedural rendering, not extracted/certified original frames.

webOutput: Vite compiles sources to hashed dynamic UI CSS/JS; integrator rebuilds. Documentation review.html is self-contained with adjacent previews.
